An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the SMB_IOC_SVCENUM IOCTL. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length, heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code under the context of the host OS. Joyent has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Joyent SmartOS SMB_IOC_SVCENUM Heap-based Buffer Overflow Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
